title: Chicken Roasted in a Sheet Pan With Croutons
description: Food & Wine test kitchen deputy editor Justin Chapple’s roast chicken drips meaty, delicious fat onto a smoky, peppery bed of potatoes, red onion and crispy croutons. “Cooking the Cover” and super easy and delicious.
ingredients: 1/2 pound sourdough boule, cut or torn into 2-inch pieces
1/2 pound (or 6 slices) slab bacon, cut into 1-by- 1/2-inch lardons
1 (or 2) large baking potato—scrubbed, halved crosswise and cut into 3/4-inch wedges
1 (preferably 2) large red onion, cut into 1-inch wedges
1/4 cup or less extra-virgin olive oil
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°. On a large rimmed baking sheet, toss the bread, bacon, potato, onion, butter, oregano and crushed red pepper with just a little olive oil and season generously with salt and black pepper. Spread in an even layer.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper and arrange on the bread mixture.

Roast the chicken and bread mixture for about 45 minutes, until the bread is crisp and an instant-read thermometer inserted in the chicken registers 160-165° for legs or thighs (155-160° for breasts). Serve.
